title: Import raw files
doc: Recognises each vendor file set with the reader that accepts it and checks it against the limits of the platform; it changes nothing.

title: Convert to mzML
doc: Writes the spectra of each sample as mzML; the version of this step names the writer.

zlib_level.title: Compression level
zlib_level.description: zlib level of the binary arrays, 0 (none) to 9 (smallest)

numpress.title: MS-Numpress
numpress.description: Lossy MS-Numpress linear prediction of m/z and short logged float of intensities, smaller files

title: Build scan index
doc: Reads the scans of each sample once and writes the .mzidx the later steps read in slices.

budget.title: Working memory
budget.description: Bytes of peaks held in memory while the index is built; the rest goes to a scratch file and the bytes of the index do not change

title: Estimate parameters
doc: Measures the noise floor, the m/z tolerance, the peak width and the dead time of each file from its own data and writes the proofs; it proposes values, the next step decides.

title: Detect features
doc: Finds the chromatographic peaks of the MS1 scans of each file, with their quality, isotopologues and families. The parameters are common to every algorithm; each algorithm adds its own.

floor.title: Noise floor
floor.description: Points below are ignored; left empty, it is estimated from the intensity histogram

mass_defect.title: Mass defect
mass_defect.description: Unit axis only: fractional part of m/z where the strong peaks pile up; measured on the file when left empty

algorithms.title: Mass traces
algorithms.doc: Builds mass traces scan by scan and cuts them at the minima; defaults and fields of trace::Params in crates/mzlab-feat/src/trace.rs.

long_trace.title: Long trace
long_trace.description: A trace longer than this is background and is not taken

algorithms.title: CentWave
algorithms.doc: Regions of interest in m/z, then a continuous wavelet transform over the expected peak widths.

references.note: CentWave: ROI detection and the wavelet peak model

applicability.note: High resolution centroided data with a known range of peak widths

algorithms.title: Threshold and derivative
algorithms.doc: Smooths each extracted chromatogram and keeps the apexes where the first derivative changes sign above the floor; fits unit resolution and few points per peak.

applicability.note: Unit resolution full scan or MRM with few points per peak

lr.title: Unit resolution
lr.evidence: LR_FLOOR and LR_MIN_HEIGHT of recipe_lr.rs; the preview proposes the values of each file

title: Align features
doc: Groups the features of all the files into rows by m/z and RT and writes the aligned table. Today one call (series::align_and_fill) does this and the filling of the gaps.

mode.title: Rows
mode.description: One row per family of ions (isotopologues, adducts, in-source fragments) or one per ion

ppm.title: m/z tolerance
ppm.description: At unit resolution the engine reads a negative value as Da

rt_gap.title: RT gap
rt_gap.description: Largest gap of RT between neighbouring features of one row

split_gap.title: Split gap
split_gap.description: A row with two features of one file (close isomers) is cut at the RT gaps above this

weak_files.title: Weak tier files
weak_files.description: Features from 0.3 of the minimum height up are kept as rows only if this many files in a run show them; 0 = no weak tier

title: Fill gaps
doc: Where a file shows no feature of a row, integrates its raw trace in the window of the row and marks the cell as filled.

ppm.title: m/z tolerance
ppm.description: At unit resolution the engine reads a negative value as Da

rt_tol.title: RT tolerance
rt_tol.description: Half width added to the window of RT

long_trace.title: Long trace
long_trace.description: A trace longer than this is background and is not taken

title: Filter table
doc: Keeps the rows that pass an ordered list of rules over the samples (campioni/2); blanks and dark files never count as samples, and a rule that cannot be evaluated is an error.

samples.title: Roles and times of the files

table.title: Table view with the rows kept

min_detected.title: Minimum files
min_detected.description: Peaks found by the detection in at least this many files that are not blanks; left empty, the rule is off

min_area.title: Minimum area
min_area.description: The largest area over the files is at least this; left empty, the rule is off

min_height.title: Minimum height
min_height.description: The largest height over the files is at least this; left empty, the rule is off

blank_ratio.title: Sample to blank ratio
blank_ratio.description: The largest area of a sample is at least this many times the mean area of the blanks; needs a blank in the samples; left empty, the rule is off

require_ms2.title: Require MS2
require_ms2.description: An MS2 is linked to the peak; left empty, the rule is off

normalize.title: Normalisation
normalize.description: Scale of the areas of each file: total area or median area

title: Link MS2 scans
doc: Attaches to each peak the MS2 scans whose precursor lies in the peak and in the isolation window, with the purity of the precursor.

default_half_window.title: Default isolation half window
default_half_window.description: Used when the index records no isolation window; the peak is then marked as estimated

tol_ppm.title: m/z tolerance
tol_ppm.description: Window of the peak in the MS1 scan of the precursor; at unit resolution the engine reads a negative value as Da

weak.title: Weak purity
weak.description: Purity below which an MS2 is weak evidence; it is not dropped

title: Export table as CSV
doc: Writes the feature table, under the view of the filter step when one is wired, as a CSV file; the column names carry the file names, so equal names give equal bytes.

samples.title: Roles and times of the files

kind.title: Format
kind.description: full: one row per feature with the summaries; full_mzmine: the same with the words of mzmine for the filled and targeted cells; quant: the areas for FBMN; csv_semicolon: the sheet of features with ;
